model: S1 SimCLR terrain encoder (ml/models.py), best of 3 seeds
representation: PCA-64 (fit on train-split cells) of 256-d S1 embeddings, int8 per-vector quantized; cosine similarity
download: gh release download ml-0.3.0 -R ikat5/mars_moon_earth_dataset -p s1_index.npz -D prepared/ml_0.3.0  (or: python -m ml.serve fetch)
use: Order Earth candidates that already pass the physical screen; never a confidence, probability or suitability score.
